mapper.select: SELECT agent_enabled, global_window_hours, global_request_limit, visitor_daily_turn_limit, account_daily_turn_limit, updated_at FROM site_config
mapper.update: UPDATE site_config SET agent_enabled = #{agentEnabled}, global_window_hours = #{globalWindowHours}, global_request_limit = #{globalRequestLimit}, visitor_daily_turn_limit = #{visitorDailyTurnLimit}, account_daily_turn_limit = #{accountDailyTurnLimit}, updated_at = GREATEST(LOCALTIMESTAMP(3), updated_at + INTERVAL '1 millisecond') WHERE updated_at = #{expectedUpdatedAt}
